 Caution signal 3 at Bangladesh ports 
 Cyclone Arnab weakens after crossing India coast
 The Report Desk 
 Published: October 28, 2026, 01:20 PM 
 -->
 -->
 Photo: Collected
 Bangladesh’s four seaports have been advised to keep local cautionary signal No. 3 as Cyclone Arnab moves inland over India and brings the risk of gusty winds and squally weather to the country’s coastal areas.
 The very severe cyclonic storm crossed the Andhra Pradesh coast on Wednesday morning and is expected to weaken gradually as it moves northwest, according to a special bulletin from the Bangladesh Meteorological Department.
 The storm is now located over Andhra Pradesh and adjoining coastal areas. 
 Its influence has also triggered deep convection over the North Bay, the bulletin said.
 The ports of Chattogram, Cox’s Bazar, Mongla and Payra have been advised to keep cautionary signal No. 3 hoisted.
 All fishing boats and trawlers in the North Bay have been advised to remain close to the coast and operate with caution until further notice.
